title: Back & Body Wellness
specs: Experienced therapists with specialized training in neuromuscular therapy, lymphatic drainage, Thai massage, and Feldenkrais method
Therapists vary massage intensity from gentle to very strong, tailored to client needs
Sports massage therapists have experience with professional and amateur athletes across many sports
Prenatal massage focuses on common pregnancy-related pain areas and uses specialized pillow systems
Prenatal massage clients are evaluated at first visit and periodically during pregnancy
Postpartum massage for clients within 8 weeks of delivery
Do not book Basic Lymphatic Drainage if diagnosed medical conditions or post surgical swelling present; book Clinical Lymphatic Drainage instead

blurb: Back & Body Wellness offers therapeutic massage sessions targeting muscle and fascia adhesions to reduce tightness, improve range of motion, and posture. They provide specialized services including sports massage, prenatal and postpartum massage, lymphatic drainage, and posture training. Sessions are tailored to client comfort and specific needs, with a variety of techniques and experienced therapists.
